findings.title: SQL Injection Risk via String Concatenation
findings.description: SQL query in Pos_SQL_Concat combines raw SQL literals with dynamic variable(s): userInput.
findings.root_cause: Direct binary concatenation (+) of dynamic values into SQL statement string.
findings.recommended_action: Replace dynamic concatenation with parameterized bind placeholders ($1, ?) and pass values to Exec/Query.

findings.title: SQL Injection Risk via Dynamic Formatting (fmt.Sprintf)
findings.description: SQL query constructed via fmt.Sprintf interpolates untrusted argument(s) [filter] directly into SQL syntax.
findings.root_cause: Direct interpolation of dynamic variables into SQL format string instead of bind placeholders.
findings.recommended_action: Use parameterized SQL placeholders ($1, ?) in query string and pass variables as execution arguments.

findings.title: Untrusted SQL Query Passed as Function Parameter
findings.description: SQL query at Query is supplied directly from function parameter rawQuery without bind parameterization.
findings.root_cause: Exposing SQL query structure directly to caller parameter.
findings.recommended_action: Pass query parameters separately using bind placeholders ($1, ?) rather than dynamic query strings.

findings.title: Command Injection Risk via Formatted Shell String
findings.description: Shell command executed via 'sh -c' dynamically formats shell string with untrusted input(s): param:userInput (string).
findings.root_cause: Formatting user variables into shell interpreter string (-c).
findings.recommended_action: Execute target binary directly without shell interpretation, passing arguments as discrete array.

findings.recommended_action: Execute target binary directly without shell interpreter (-c).

findings.title: Command Injection Risk via Shell Interpreter
findings.description: Command string in Pos_Cmd_ShellParamDirect at line 32 is passed directly from function parameter 'commandString' to shell interpreter 'sh -c'.
findings.root_cause: Executing arbitrary untrusted shell strings with shell interpretation (-c).
findings.recommended_action: Invoke target executable directly with discrete arguments instead of passing shell commands through 'sh -c'.

findings.title: Deferred Resource Release Inside Loop (os.File)
findings.description: Resource 'f' acquired in loop with 'defer Close()'; cleanup is delayed until function exit, accumulating descriptors.
findings.root_cause: Registering deferred cleanup inside loop body.
findings.recommended_action: Close resource explicitly at the end of each loop iteration or encapsulate loop body in a helper function.

findings.title: Unclosed System Resource Leak (os.File)
findings.description: Resource handle 'f' of type os.File acquired in function 'Pos_Res_LinearFileLeak' at line 21 is never closed along normal execution paths.
findings.root_cause: Resource handle acquired without explicit or deferred release call along reachable exit paths.
findings.recommended_action: Ensure 'defer f.Close()' is called immediately following successful acquisition error checking.

findings.title: Unclosed System Resource Leak (net.Conn)

findings.recommended_action: Ensure 'defer conn.Close()' is called immediately following successful acquisition error checking.

findings.title: Conditional Resource Leak on Exit Path (os.File)
findings.description: Resource 'f' is released on some execution paths but leaks along 1 of 3 reachable exits.
findings.root_cause: Conditional release branch does not cover all function exit paths.
findings.recommended_action: Unify cleanup under a top-level deferred release.

findings.title: Unhandled Error Return (json.Unmarshal)
